posts.title: Catching Panics in Production
posts.description: When writing services in Rust I’ve always aimed for zero panics in production. Aside from general correctness and code quality this also improves the API quality - our user should always expect a response from a HTTP endpoint with a meaningful status code and body when there’s an error.
